title: legal — index
body:
Dan's own legal history and live property/dispute exposure. Other people's
legal events (Annie's October 2025 arrest, Tom's 2025 DUI) live on their
people pages, not here. Workplace disputes that never became legal actions
live in work/ — see [[wiki/work/bfs-foods]] for the 2026 BFS drawer dispute.

- [[wiki/legal/2015-possession-arrest]] — Dan's only real arrest: a 3am traffic stop in downtown Uniontown on a lemon run for Suz, an impound-triggered inventory search, and three drug charges including a Class B count over cocaine residue. Resolved by ARD in February 2016 against a DA policy that barred it. Closed.
- [[wiki/legal/2015-retail-theft-arrest]] — the Combos incident: a separate retail theft a few weeks after the arrest, surviving in the corpus almost entirely as a running joke. Closed. A single October 2017 message references an otherwise unrecorded prior DUI — flagged as a CONTRADICTION on the possession-arrest page.
- [[wiki/legal/463-morgantown]] — the live housing/property situation: no-lease occupancy, Suz's blended roles, contractor lien risk (~July 2026 deadline). Active.
- [[wiki/timeline/events/uniontown-hospital-vape-alarm]] — filed under timeline/, noted here as the corpus's second brush with charging paperwork: a vape set off a hospital-wide fire alarm during Fran's April 2018 death watch, four fire trucks, escorted off the property. Whether anything was ever filed is unverified.
